### 1. High-level Design Pattern Extraction

> **Skill Name**: Modern Portfolio Hero Section with Layered Backgrounds

*   **Core Visual Mechanism**: This design creates an engaging hero section using a horizontal split layout, where prominent textual content resides on the left and a large, personal portrait image (integrated into the background) anchors the right. A subtle geometric pattern underpins the entire section, adding depth. The core style signature is the effective layering of multiple background images and the use of modern CSS Flexbox for a clean, responsive content arrangement.

*   **Why Use This Skill (Rationale)**: This hero section is designed to make a strong first impression. The clear visual hierarchy immediately draws the user's eye to the main message and the individual being presented (via the portrait). The balance between textual information and a compelling image, combined with a clear call-to-action, enhances user engagement and communicates professionalism. The subtle background texture adds visual interest without distracting from the main content.

*   **Overall Applicability**: This style is highly applicable for personal portfolio websites, professional landing pages for freelancers or consultants, "about me" sections, or introductory areas for any service-oriented website. It effectively showcases a person and their primary offerings in an aesthetically pleasing and modern way.

*   **Value Addition**: Compared to a basic static hero image or plain text, this pattern provides dynamic visual interest through layered backgrounds and well-structured content presentation. It enhances branding, improves readability, and guides user interaction through a prominent call-to-action, all while maintaining responsiveness.

*   **Browser Compatibility**: The component relies on standard HTML5 elements and widely supported CSS features such as Flexbox, `position: fixed`, `calc()`, `vh` units, and multiple `background-image` properties. These are well-supported across all modern browsers. No experimental features are used.

### 2. Visual & Technical Breakdown

*   **Step A: Core Visual Elements**
    *   **HTML Elements**:
        *   `header`: Contains logo (text-based `<a>`), main navigation (`<ul><li><a>`), and social media links (image-based `<a>`).
        *   `main`: Contains two primary content `div`s.
            *   `main-intro`: For the primary `h1` title, descriptive `p` paragraph, and a call-to-action `a` link.
            *   `main-quotes`: For two quote `p` elements.
    *   **Color Logic**:
        *   Primary Background (`body`): Dark gray (`#1d1d1d`).
        *   Hero Section Background (`main`): Dark blue (`#1A253A`).
        *   Text Color: White (`#ffffff`).
        *   Header Background: White (`#ffffff`).
        *   Header Text Color: Black (`#000000`).
        *   Accent Color (Logo, Button, Quote Borders, Hover States): Bright magenta-purple (`#fc13b4`). Hover state is a darker variant (`#9e2f6e`).
    *   **Typographic Hierarchy**: Uses Google Fonts 'Roboto'.
        *   `h1`: Large, bold (600 weight), white, uppercase. `font-size: 96px`, `line-height: 106px`.
        *   `p`: Standard `font-size: 18px`, `line-height: 30px`, white, regular weight.
        *   `a` (button): `font-size: 18px`, `font-weight: 500`, white, uppercase.
        *   Navigation (`header-main-nav a`): `font-weight: 400`, `color: #000000`.

*   **Step B: Layout & Compositional Style**
    *   **Layout System**: CSS Flexbox is the primary layout tool.
        *   `header-main`: `display: flex`, `justify-content: space-between`, `align-items: center` to distribute logo, nav, and social icons.
        *   `main`: `display: flex`, `justify-content: center`, `align-items: center` to horizontally and vertically center its child content sections. A `gap: 20vh` separates the two content blocks.
    *   **Spatial Feel, Alignment Principles**: The header is `position: fixed` at the top, `60px` tall. The `main` section's height is dynamically calculated as `calc(100vh - 60px)` to fill the remaining viewport. Content blocks within `main` are relatively positioned (`right: 20vh` for `main-intro`, `left: 4vh` for `main-quotes`) to achieve an asymmetrical, balanced feel, respecting the visual space taken by the portrait image.
    *   **Background Composition**: `main` utilizes multiple `background-image` layers:
        *   Foreground (top layer): `portrait.png` (the user's image). `background-size: 70vh` (70% of viewport height), `background-position: bottom center`.
        *   Background (bottom layer): `bg.png` (geometric pattern). `background-size: cover`, `background-position: center`.
        *   Both backgrounds are `background-repeat: no-repeat`.
    *   **Z-index Layering**: Header has `z-index: 1000` to ensure it always appears above scrolling content. No specific `z-index` is set for `main`'s children, relying on their natural flow and background layering.

*   **Step C: Interactive Behavior & Animations**
    *   **Hover Effects**:
        *   Navigation links: Text color changes to accent color (`var(--site-color-01)`) on hover.
        *   Call-to-action button: Background color darkens on hover (`var(--site-color-01-hover)`).
    *   **Transitions**: Implicit `transition: color 0.3s ease` and `transition: background-color 0.3s ease` are used for smooth hover animations.
    *   **JavaScript**: No specific interactive JavaScript is implemented for the hero section itself in the tutorial. The `script.js` file is empty.

### 3. Reproduction Code

#### 3a. Implementation Method Selection

| Aspect of the effect | Method | Why this method |
|---|---|---|
| Main layout (header, hero sections) | CSS Flexbox with `position: fixed` | Provides flexible and responsive container arrangement. `position: fixed` is standard for sticky headers. |
| Full viewport height for hero content | CSS `calc()` with `vh` units | Ensures the hero section fills the available screen space below the header, adapting to various screen sizes. |
| Layered background images (portrait + pattern) | Multiple `background-image` URLs with `background-size`, `background-position` | Allows precise control over the stacking, sizing, and placement of multiple images within a single element's background. |
| Custom Google Fonts | `<link>` to Google Fonts CDN | Simplifies font integration without local hosting. |
| Text styling (size, weight, uppercase, color) | Standard CSS typography properties | Direct control over font appearance. |
| Button styling and hover effect | `<a>` tag styled with CSS `background-color`, `padding`, `border-radius`, and `:hover` pseudo-class | Achieves a button-like appearance and interactive feedback using only CSS. |
| Consistent theming | CSS Custom Properties (`--var`) | Centralizes color definitions for easy theme adjustments. |
| Content offsetting within Flexbox | CSS `position: relative` with `left`/`right` properties | Used to fine-tune horizontal alignment of content blocks for visual balance with the portrait image. |
| Image placeholders | Transparent Base64 PNGs via Python | Ensures code reproducibility even if specific image files are not locally available, providing a visual placeholder. |

> **Feasibility Assessment**: 100% of the visual effect shown in the video for the hero section is reproducible using the chosen HTML and CSS methods. The Python function generates all required files, including dummy images, ensuring self-contained execution.

    quote2_author: str = "- Benjamin Franklin",
    color_scheme: str = "dark",        # "dark" or "light"

    width_px: int = 1200,              # Not directly used for full-width components, but can be for container max-width
    height_px: int = 800,              # Not directly used, as height is 100vh - header_height

) -> dict:
    """
    Create a web component reproducing the Modern Portfolio Hero Section visual effect.

    """
    os.makedirs(output_dir, exist_ok=True)

    if color_scheme == "dark":
        bg_main_color = "#1A253A" # Dark blue from video
        bg_body_color = "#1d1d1d" # General body background color
        text_color = "#ffffff"

        header_text_color = "#000000"
    else: # Light theme equivalent
        bg_main_color = "#e6f0f8" # Lighter blue
        bg_body_color = "#f8f9fa" # Lighter gray

    css = f"""/* Modern Portfolio Hero Section with Layered Backgrounds — generated component */
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Roboto:ital,wght@0,100;0,300;0,400;0,500;0,700;0,900;1,100;1,300;1,400;1,500;1,700;1,900&display=swap');

*, *::before, *::after {{
    margin: 0;

    box-sizing: border-box;
}}

:root {{

}}

}}

}}

.header-main {{

    background-image: url('img/portrait.png'), url('img/bg.png'); /* Layered backgrounds */
    background-size: 70vh, cover; /* Scale portrait to 70% viewport height, cover pattern */

    display: flex;

    align-items: center; /* Center flex items vertically */
    gap: 20vh; /* Space between the two content sections */
}}

/* Left Text Content Section */

}}

}}

    text-decoration: none;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    font-weight: 500;

}}

/* Right Quotes Section */
.main-quotes {{

}}
.main-quotes p:nth-child(2) {{ /* Target the second quote */
    margin-top: 60px; /* Custom spacing between quotes */
}}

"""
